title: Punk 57
author: Penelope Douglas
summary: Misha and Ryen were anonymous pen pals as children, writing as Punk 57 and Dear Stranger. Years later they meet at the same high school and clash without realising who the other is.
readIf: you like angsty teen-to-young-adult romance with sharp banter and a slow reveal.
skipIf: you want a gentle romance without bullying, rough language or heavy tension.
